details.publicNotes:
The stormadillo is a bulky, short-legged mammal with an armored leather shell and the ability to mark its territory with static electricity, allowing it to trap its prey and bulldoze over it at terrifying speeds. Despite their lack of vocalization, a chorus of electrical pops and snaps often heralds their arrival.

Stormadillos are omnivores, but they quickly strip the vegetation from their preferred rocky mountain environments. They are fiercely territorial and tend to challenge anything their size or smaller that encroaches on the significant territory they patrol. However, they are cautious fighters and only engage in combat with larger creatures when cornered or protecting their young. As a result, some giant communities have had success domesticating stormadillos.

A typical adult stormadillo is 13 feet long from head to tail and weighs roughly 400 pounds. The static electricity that infuses a stormadillo's body makes metal objects stick to it, forming an extra layer of protection around its body. Stormadillos have learned to deliberately cultivate these collections to enhance their shells' natural defenses, gathering an eclectic hodgepodge of everything from cooking pots and gardening tools to loose coins and small weapons.

Bad Neighbors

Stormadillos live in the same storm-wracked hills and mountains that volt rams inhabit, and the two species often come into conflict. In competition for the same scarce pasture lands and high peaks on which to catch the occasional lightning bolt, stormadillos and volt rams often engage in thunderous clashes, with the volt ram charging impetuously forward and the stormadillo rolling into the volt ram's horns like a bowling ball.

Monster Parts 30/65/125 gp

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, constitution, electricity, energy resistant (electricity, vitality), sensory (scent), strength, wild, wisdom

description.value: The stormadillo coils into a ball to defend itself. It gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC. The stormadillo's speed is reduced to 10 feet, and it can't use its claw attacks or take other actions that require it to use its limbs while in its Curl. It can unfurl as a single action with the manipulate trait, ending the effects of Curl.

The stormadillo can cling to electrically charged terrain (such as terrain affected by Electrify Domain) and roll along it at great speeds. As long as the stormadillo is clinging to such a surface, it can't be knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} or subject to forced movement, and it can move along walls and ceilings at its full Speed. The stormadillo's Speed increases to 40 feet, or 60 feet while using Curl. If a stormadillo using Static Cling moves out of electrified terrain at any point, its movement immediately ends.

Medium or smaller, shell, @Check[reflex|dc:24|basic]. Trample deals an additional @Damage[1d8[electricity]] damage if the Stormadillo is using Static Cling.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Trample]

The stormadillo slams its claws on the ground, creating a @Template[line|distance:120|width:10]{10-foot wide, 120-foot long line} of electricity that travels along surfaces (including walls and ceilings), dealing @Damage[2d8[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures along the line and leaving a lingering band of electrified terrain that persists for 1 minute. Any creature in the line must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:24] save.

Critical Success The target takes no damage.

Success The target takes half damage.

Failure The target takes full damage and takes a –10-foot penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. As normal, this penalty can't reduce a creature's Speed below 5 feet. @UUID[Compendium.battlezoo-bestiary-es-pf2e.sf2e-effects.Item.QU3UbhbYXc4OckPM]{Effect: Electrify Domain}

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round.
